Signing: HMAC-SHA256 per the Standard Webhooks spec — headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>` over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body`, key from a `whsec_<base64>` secret (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:130-146`, `:91-104`).

**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) — `internal/filter/` (`engine.go` compiles the expression, `schema.go` defines the env/fields, `ir.go` the dialect-agnostic condition tree, `render.go` the SQL rendering, `parser.go`/`helpers.go` support). Mechanism: the handler passes `ListMemosRequest.filter` into `store.FindMemo.Filters`; each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` then `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect<X>, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57,61`; likewise postgres/mysql), which compiles CEL to a shared condition tree and `render.go` emits dialect-specific SQL fragments + bind args (`internal/filter/render.go:231-237,365-...,502-...`) that are ANDed into the `WHERE` clause.

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus each comment memo row), `memo_relation`, `attachment`. Reaction rows are only read for the webhook payload, not deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545-582`; `store/memo.go:140-158`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the Vite build output is embedded into the Go binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-61` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
- `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`; started at `server/server.go:162-172`: one immediate `RunOnce`, then a `time.Ticker` every 12 h (`runner.go:27,30-39`)
- webhook async dispatch workers — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:41-53`: 4 goroutines started in `init()`, driven by the `asyncPostQueue` channel (event-driven, not scheduled)

Unused infra: `internal/scheduler/` (cron parser/scheduler/middleware) is referenced only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`) — nothing in the server uses it. Likewise `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19`) is never instantiated; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is used inline by the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:150-175`, applied to the shared Connect transport (`:179-184`). Token kinds it manages: a short-lived **access token** (JWT, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, stored/expiry-tracked in `web/src/auth-state.ts`, refreshed proactively and on 401) and a **refresh token** delivered as an HttpOnly cookie `memos_refresh` (sent via `credentials: "include"`, `web/src/connect.ts:59-64`; cookie name at `server/auth/token.go:49`). Personal Access Tokens are also accepted by the backend for programmatic clients. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go` — `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT`; `token.go` for parsing/generation), invoked from `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` (`Authorizer`) via the gateway middleware and Connect `NewAuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68-93,131-141`).

**q30.**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.created`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:16`
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.updated`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:21`
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`memos.memo.deleted`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:26`
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.comment.created`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30`

The first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:175`), which queues to the worker pool that calls `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:118`).
